rationale: The assistant correctly recognised a TV as outside its nine-family scope, declined cleanly, pointed to 'The manufacturer's support line or a specialist electronics repairer', and added the relevant safety warning 'please don't open the case, as the power supply inside can hold a dangerous charge'. Nothing was invented and no diagnosis or part was offered. It missed the optional opportunity to suggest simple non-invasive pointers (check input source, power reset, torch test) or to ask whether there is sound or any smell, which would have made the decline more useful to the homeowner.
